page.overview:
Who is Kaato Higashikata?

Kaato is Norisuke Higashikata IV's former wife and the mother of four children. She is arrested and put in jail for 15 years after being accused for murdering a child. She is a Stand User with a playing card-based stand named Space Trucking.

Kaato is a 52-year-old woman with shoulder-length black hair, parted in the middle with two spiral buns on each side which end in two spiraling pigtails.

She wears a long dress with a layer of fringe along the waist and with playing card back designs with the Higashikata family crest across her chest and on her hips. She also wears large rectangular bracelets on both of her wrists. A later version exposes her cleavage.

Kaato herself acts incredibly loving towards her children, however, she is not above violently reprimanding them if she is disrespected; as shown when Joshu intentionally tripped her with a chair, and also tore her bra and dress. Kaato initially dislikes Josuke, calling him a freeloader and generally looking down upon him for being taken in.
